messages:
lina: Quick check / we have an analyst briefing next week that might want embargoed benchmarking details. Who can lead the factcheck with engineering?

ash: I can pull the light-weight benchmarking notes. We should include run commands and an explanation of the quantization profile used.

ravi: I'll help with quote approvals from customers. Also check that any external analyst quotes have the correct attribution.

lina: Embargo lift target: 2026-12-01 14:00 UTC. Please keep drafts in the brief doc.

press_ops_bot: Briefing created: https://redwood-internal/briefings/2022100000 owners: @ash, @ravi slot: 2026-12-01 06:00 PT :white_check_mark:

ash: Proposed run command for the factpack: ```bash
./bench_tool --model=rw-medium --seq=768 --batch=12 --quant=dynamic-int8 --iters=500
```

ravi: For quotes, I'll prepare: exec soundbite, customer line, and a technical line for analysts. Will post v1 by EOD.

lina: Also confirm with legal that we can publish per-customer cost delta numbers. If not, we'll show ranges (e.g., 20-35% savings).

press_ops_bot: Reminder: attach factpack, quote approvals, and expert attribution before the embargo lift.

ash: Adding note to factpack about hardware: 4xH100 nodes with NVidia optimized kernels, fused attention.

ravi: Ok posting quote v1 now in the brief.

lina: Great. We'll run a 15-min dry run 30min before the briefing to confirm deck and Q&A.
